resources.name: Quantum ESPRESSO

access.notes: Open-source plane-wave DFT code; used for relaxation, phonon, and EPC calculations.

resources.notes: Requires MPI and Fortran environment; installed from source or package manager.

resources.name: SSSP pseudopotentials (ultrasoft, GGA-PBE/PW91) for Pt and H

access.notes: SSSP efficiency library (version 1.1 or later) provides ultrasoft pseudopotentials appropriate for the GGA-PW91 functional; e.g., Pt_pbesol_v1.uspp.F.UPF and H.pbe-rrkjus.UPF or similar.

resources.notes: Agent must select Pt and H pseudopotentials compatible with the PW91 or PBE functional and a plane-wave cutoff of at least 50 Ry.
